caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a drinking glass, placed centrally on a plain, beige-colored background. The glass is rendered in varying shades of purple and is shown in a slightly elevated frontal perspective. The glass has a broad, round opening at the top and tapers gradually towards a narrower base. The surface of the glass is decorated with a repeating pattern of elongated, pointed arches that start near the rim and extend downward, giving the appearance of vertical facets. The inner surface, rim, and base of the glass are also colored in shades of purple, creating an overall translucent effect. Near the lower right-hand corner of the drawing, the name "JOHN DANA" is written in small, uppercase letters. There is a small scale or measurement line located in the bottom left corner of the drawing. The composition is simple, with the glass being the only colored and detailed object on an otherwise blank background.
title: Tumbler
